description: This file defines the ApplicationViewModel class, which manages the state and behavior of the application's main view model, including handling different calculator modes, window display options, and user commands.

classes.name: ApplicationViewModel
classes.description: Main view model managing calculator modes, window display options, and user commands within the calculator application.

methods.name: ToggleAlwaysOnTop
methods.description: Toggles the calculator window between normal and compact overlay modes, saving size preferences and updating state accordingly.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the view model with a specified mode, falling back to standard mode if invalid.

methods.name: RestoreFromSnapshot
methods.description: Restores the view model state from a saved snapshot.

methods.name: OnModeChanged
methods.description: Handles logic to execute when the calculator mode changes, including initializing view models and updating UI state.

methods.name: OnCopyCommand
methods.description: Executes copy command based on current mode.

methods.name: OnPasteCommand
methods.description: Executes paste command based on current mode.

methods.name: SetDisplayNormalAlwaysOnTopOption
methods.description: Updates the display option for normal always-on-top based on current mode and support.

methods.name: TryRecoverFromNavigationModeFailure
methods.description: Attempts to recover from failure to navigate to a specific mode by falling back to standard mode.

methods.name: RaisePropertyChanged
methods.description: Raises the PropertyChanged event for data binding updates.
